evaluationForm.memberRequired: Choose the team member to evaluate before saving.
evaluationForm.campaignRequired: Choose the evaluation campaign (the period) this evaluation belongs to.
evaluationForm.campaignClosed: The campaign "{{name}}" is closed and no longer accepts new evaluations. Choose an open campaign or ask for this one to be reopened.
evaluationForm.campaignUsed: {{member}} already has an evaluation for the campaign "{{name}}". Open it from the evaluations list to edit it instead of creating a second one.
evaluationForm.noSkills: No skills to rate: {{member}} has no skills framework linked to their position or department. Ask your administrator to set it up.
evaluationForm.noSkillSelected: No skill is ticked: tick at least one skill to evaluate.
evaluationForm.missingScores: The current score is missing for {{count}} ticked skill(s): {{names}}. Rate them all, or untick those that do not apply to this person.
evaluationForm.scoreRange: {{label}} for "{{skill}}" must be between 1 and 5 (you entered {{value}}).
evaluationForm.scoreDecimals: {{label}} for "{{skill}}" accepts one decimal only (you entered {{value}}): write for instance 3.5.
evaluationForm.businessRange: The Business score must be between 0 and 200 % (you entered {{value}} %).
evaluationForm.peopleRange: The People score must be between 0 and 200 % (you entered {{value}} %).
evaluationForm.decimalsPercent: The {{which}} score accepts one decimal only (you entered {{value}} %): write for instance 85.5.

campaigns.nameRequired: Give the campaign a name (for example: Semester 2 2026).
campaigns.nameTooLong: The campaign name is too long ({{count}} characters): 100 characters maximum.
campaigns.nameDuplicate: A campaign named "{{name}}" already exists. Choose a different name to tell them apart (for example: {{name}} bis).
campaigns.startInvalid: The start date is not a valid date: pick it from the calendar (DD/MM/YYYY).
campaigns.endInvalid: The end date is not a valid date: pick it from the calendar (DD/MM/YYYY).
campaigns.endBeforeStart: The end date ({{end}}) is before the start date ({{start}}). Choose an end date on or after the start.

evaluations.campaignClosed: The campaign "{{name}}" is closed and no longer accepts new evaluations. Choose an open campaign, or reopen this one from the campaigns page.
evaluations.alreadyEvaluated: {{name}} already has an evaluation for the campaign "{{campaign}}". You can view it here; to evaluate another period, change the selected period.

matrix.compareReset: The compared period was the same as the displayed period: the comparison has been removed.

strengths.scoreWithoutText: {{where}}: an index ({{score}}) is entered without a label. Describe the strength or weakness, or clear the index.
strengths.duplicateInColumn: {{where}}: "{{text}}" already appears above in this column. Remove the duplicate.
strengths.contradiction: "{{text}}" is both a strength and a weakness ({{section}}). The same skill cannot be in both columns.
strengths.tooLong: {{where}}: the text exceeds 255 characters ({{count}}). Shorten it.
strengths.rangeScore: {{where}}: the index must be between 1 and 5 (you entered {{value}}).
strengths.notLoaded: The sheet could not be loaded: saving now would replace its existing content with an empty sheet. Refresh the page and try again.

objectives.notNumber: {{where}}: {{field}} "{{value}}" is not a number. Enter a number, for example 1250 or 12.5.
objectives.tooManyDecimals: {{where}}: {{field}} accepts two decimals at most (you entered "{{value}}").
objectives.tooLarge: {{where}}: {{field}} "{{value}}" is too large (12 digits before the decimal point at most).
objectives.weightNegative: {{where}}: the weighting coefficient cannot be negative (you entered {{value}}). Enter 0 or a positive number.
objectives.weightTooLarge: {{where}}: the weighting coefficient cannot exceed 999.99 (you entered {{value}}).
objectives.labelTooLong: {{where}}: the objective label exceeds 500 characters ({{count}}). Shorten it.
objectives.indicatorTooLong: {{where}}: the indicator exceeds 255 characters ({{count}}). Shorten it.
objectives.dateInvalid: {{field}} is not a valid date: pick it from the calendar (DD/MM/YYYY).
objectives.evaluatedBeforeSet: The evaluation date ({{evaluated}}) is before the objectives-setting date ({{set}}). Objectives are set before they are evaluated: correct one of the two dates.
objectives.nextBeforeEvaluated: The next evaluation date ({{next}}) is not after the evaluation date ({{evaluated}}). Choose a later date.
objectives.nextBeforeSet: The next evaluation date ({{next}}) is before the objectives-setting date ({{set}}). Choose a later date.
objectives.visaTooLong: The visa exceeds 150 characters ({{count}}). Shorten it.
objectives.notSaved: These corrections are not saved yet: the sheet keeps the last valid values until the points above are fixed.

managerial.campaignRequired: First choose the campaign concerned before saving.
managerial.nothingEntered: The "{{category}}" sheet is empty: rate at least one statement (or enter an objective) before saving.
managerial.objectiveRange: Statement {{order}}: the objective must be between 1 and 5 (you entered {{value}}).
managerial.objectiveDecimals: Statement {{order}}: the objective accepts one decimal only (you entered {{value}}): write for instance 3.5.
managerial.commentTooLong: Statement {{order}}: the comment exceeds 255 characters ({{count}}). Shorten it.
managerial.synthesisEmpty: The summary is empty: enter at least one key skill or one area for improvement.
managerial.synthesisDuplicate: "{{text}}" is entered twice in "{{section}}". Remove the duplicate.
managerial.synthesisContradiction: "{{text}}" appears both in your key skills and in your areas for improvement. A skill cannot be both: keep it in one list only.
managerial.synthesisTooLong: "{{section}}", answer {{n}}: more than 255 characters ({{count}}). Shorten it.

monkey.campaignRequired: First choose the campaign concerned before saving.
monkey.nothingEntered: The self-diagnosis is empty: rate at least one statement or fill in one of the free-text answers before saving.
monkey.monkeyDuplicate: "{{text}}" is entered twice in the monkeys list. Remove the duplicate.
monkey.tooManyMonkeys: You can list 3 monkeys at most (you entered {{count}}).
